_note: Facts checked by hand on each vendor's own site on the date shown. Anything not listed here is 'unknown' on the site. Never add a value without a source URL.

QuickBooks (Intuit).price_note: Sole Trader Plus is £10/month and Simple Start is £18/month (list prices). Sole Trader Plus can't submit VAT returns. Every plan includes 'Calculate and submit CIS' and a 30-day free trial.

affiliate.note: UK publisher programme listed as Active on FlexOffers on 23 Nov 2026. Payout 16% of online sales and free trials (QBOA accountant purchases excluded); 30-day cookie; paid in USD. FlexOffers terms (updated 15 June 2026) pay monthly on NET 60 and require a verified live traffic source. Programme page last update 12 January 2026.

QuickBooks (Intuit).price_evidence_note: Plan prices on the pricing page load from Intuit's own UK price list (billing_offers_gb.json, generated 20 Nov 2026). Read 23 Nov 2026: 'QBO St Plus GB Monthly Trial 10 GBP' (list price, basePrice 10) and 'QBO Simple Start GB Monthly Trial 18.0 GBP' (list price, basePrice 18). The rendered pricing page (also read 23 Nov 2026) lists Sole Trader Plus, Simple Start, Essentials, Plus and Advanced, each 'Free for 30 days', and says VAT submission is not available with Sole Trader Plus. VAT treatment of the list price was not stated in the text we could read. Saved copy: data/raw/pricing/quickbooks-billing-offers-2026-11-23.txt.

Xero.price_note: Ignite plan, then £18/month excl. VAT. Intro offer at check (23 Nov 2026): 90% off for the first 6 months (£1.80/month excl. VAT); the page also offers one month free. Ignite lists 'MTD for Income Tax ready' and CIS calculations.

affiliate.note: Official UK publisher/review-site programme hosted on PartnerStack; free to join. Xero's own page does not publish a rate (discussed after joining). PartnerStack programme directory listed $200 per qualified purchase on 23 Nov 2026. Agreement: a new non-accounting/bookkeeping business signs up via the link and buys a paying Business Edition subscription within 35 days. Cookie length not stated.

Sage Sole Trader & Landlord Free.price_note: Sage Sole Trader Free: 'Completely free, no billing.' 25 auto-categorised transactions per month, 1 bank account, records landlord income and expenses, Making Tax Digital ready.

affiliate.note: Covered by the same Sage UK & Ireland Affiliate Programme (Impact.com) as the paid product; free to join. Official FAQ names SBCA and Sage Intacct as commissionable; whether the free Sole Trader MTD product pays is not stated on Sage's official page. Commission and cookie length are not published there. Read 23 Nov 2026.

Sage Sole Trader & Landlord.price_note: Sage Sole Trader plan, £7/month excl. VAT. Intro offer at check (23 Nov 2026): 90% off for 10 months (£0.70/month excl. 20% VAT), then £7/month.

affiliate.note: Official Sage UK & Ireland Affiliate Programme for publishers and comparison sites, tracked and paid via Impact.com; free to join. Official page does not publish commission or cookie length. FAQ names Sage Business Cloud Accounting (SBCA) and Sage Intacct as commissionable. Read 23 Nov 2026.

FreeAgent.price_note: Prices for UK sole traders and unincorporated landlords. Intro offer at check: 50% off for the first six months. 30-day free trial.

affiliate.note: No public publisher affiliate programme found. The customer referral scheme (terms updated 3 Feb 2026) gives a 10% subscription discount, not a cash commission, and is for existing subscribers only; terms forbid distributing a code in exchange for payment. The Partner Programme is for accountants and bookkeepers only.

FreeAgent for free with Mettle, NatWest.price_note: Free while you keep a NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland or Ulster Bank business current account, or a Mettle account with at least one transaction a month.

Zoho.price_text: Free plan; paid from £10/month billed annually
Zoho.price_note: Zoho Books Free plan is £0 and lists MTD for Income Tax (Sole Traders & Landlords tab). Standard plan is £10/org/month billed annually (£12 billed monthly), with a free trial.

affiliate.note: In-house Zoho Affiliate Program, open to individuals and website owners. Standard tier 15% of revenue/list price for the first 12 months (18% and 20% higher tiers); 90-day cookie; 60-day stickiness; free to join. Applications reviewed within five business days. Agreement last updated 7 October 2026. Read 23 Nov 2026.

No public publisher affiliate programme found on 23 Nov 2026. Letting-agent and accountant pages invite recommendations or licence discounts but do not publish a publisher commission. Partner terms (updated 20 Oct 2022) are a reseller-style arrangement in which the partner pays Hammock subscription fees.

Coconut.price_note: MTD Bridging plan £49.99/year (quarterly updates from a spreadsheet; year-end submission is a £49.99 add-on). MTD filing plan £12.99/month or £129.99/year. 14-day free trial.

affiliate.note: No public publisher affiliate programme found on 23 Nov 2026. The accountant Partner Programme is for practices. The customer refer-a-friend scheme (help article 9 Feb 2026) gives monthly-paying customers one free month, not a cash commission. The Partners page is aimed at brands wanting exposure to Coconut's audience.

Coconut Free.price_note: HMRC lists a free Coconut product; its limits were not checked.

Clear Books Free.price_note: Sole Trader Free, Property Free and Foreign Property Free (one property) plans at £0.

Clear Books.price_note: Sole Trader £5/month, Property £5/month, Sole Trader Plus (VAT-registered) £15/month, all excl. VAT. 30-day free trial.

affiliate.note: No public publisher programme or published commission found on 23 Nov 2026. Terms of Use (last updated 26 May 2022), clause 13, say Clear Books may run an affiliate scheme in which subscribers receive a benefit (not stated) when a referred person signs up and pays. Accountants, bookkeepers and resellers are not eligible. No public sign-up page was found.

Acorah Software Products Ltd (TaxCalc).price_note: TaxCalc MTD Quarterly Filer is aimed at accountants filing for clients from spreadsheets.

VitalTax.price_note: Excel add-in. One NI number £30 + VAT per year, covering all quarterly submissions for that person; unlimited licence £198 + VAT.

Abridge (MTD for Excel/Sheets).price_note: Full MTD Coverage plan: quarterly updates and final declaration, from Excel, Google Sheets or file upload.

Absolute Excel Income Tax Filer.price_note: Price covers 5 National Insurance numbers for a tax year.

My Tax Digital (Free).price_note: Describes itself as free MTD software for Income Tax and VAT, with a bridging mode that imports spreadsheet figures.

TaxPig.price_note: Free Community Edition (£0/month, 50 receipt scans). TaxPig Pro £7.50/month.

RentalBux Free.price_note: Free plan for basic MTD compliance. Joint ownership splits are on paid plans.

GetGround.price_note: MTD for landlords free with GetGround's Basic plan.

Aligned.tax MTD for Spreadsheets.price_note: Filing your own quarterly updates is free for individuals; accountants pay per client from the 2027/28 tax year.

MTD Sheets.price_note: First submission free, then £2.99 per submission (from 49p each in bulk).

PaTMa Property Manager.price_note: Free plan covers 1 rental unit. Pro £15/month including VAT for 5 units (extra units £1.50/month). 14-day Pro trial.

Provestor for Landlords.price_note: DIY plan shown at £69 for the first year with a £99/year regular price. Check VAT basis on the source page.

Taxzap.price_note: For non-VAT-registered sole traders and landlords.

Pandle.price_note: Free Pandle plan; Pandle Pro £5/month + VAT.

Landlord Vision.price_note: Starter plan (4 tenancies) shown at £7.99/month with '60% off for the 2 years', against £19.97. VAT basis not confirmed on the captured page.

Landlord Studio.price_text: Free up to 3 properties + £5 per MTD submission; Pro £12 + VAT/month
Landlord Studio.price_note: MTD Go plan is free for up to 3 properties but charges £5 per MTD tax submission. Pro £12 + VAT/month includes MTD submissions.

IRIS Kashflow.price_note: Intro offer at check: 90% off for 6 months (£1.35/month).
